messages:
maria: heads up marketplace images show a regression after CUDA 12.2 + driver 540.x landed in some partner runs. need quick alignment on pinning + hotfix cadence. @alex any brief CI summary?

alex: short: 12-15% p99 lift on batched workloads, reproducible under multi-tenant queueing. single-node baseline OK. nvml timeouts in logs. repro in CI artifacts.

maria: recommendation: pin to driver 535.86 + CUDA 12.1 in image manifests as a temporary stable lane and notify marketplace/cloud partners.

nvidia-eng: we can cut a 535.86-based bundle with scheduler tweak and perf validations. will share checksum and install steps by EOD.

jonathan: we should add a `driver_pin` field to image metadata and an automated gating rule on upload to warn about unpinned stacks.

shiv: rollout plan: build pinned images -> 5% canary on marketplace test accounts -> monitor p99/throughput -> expand if green. aim: canary tomorrow 07:00 UTC.

maria: ops mitigations: tell customers to set `driver_pin: 535.86` in manifest and restart runtime if they see p99 regressions. I'll draft partner notice.

deploy-bot: canary-job/2310012350 -> FAILED :red_circle: 
Summary: batch_latency exceeded alert threshold. Logs: https://ci.internal/runs/2310012350/logs

alex: confirmed. nvml call stack shows timing out under contention. will prepare minimal repro + kernel cmdline.

nvidia-eng: if canary fails we'll recommend pinned image backroll and provide fallback installer to auto-downgrade driver where possible.

jonathan: will PR manifest schema change and add gating check in marketplace uploader today.

shiv: action items recorded. if canary fails we stop rollout and issue partner notice with rollback steps.

maria: thanks everyone. I'll post partner notice draft here in ~1.5h. :mailbox_with_mail:
